answer: An applicant enters the mesa registry only after locking a 180-unit velvet bond for sixteen days and publishing three marble receipts. Each receipt is the hash of a job-nonce and a rater public key, and the three raters must be established at least eighteen days, share no sponsor, and come from pairwise-disjoint neighborhoods. If two later receipts share a twelve-bit prefix, or two raters later collapse under one sponsor, the clerk slashes 75% of the velvet bond and freezes that mesa slot for two epochs. A rater may issue at most one marble ticket per day.
